> Chapter 16 Demon Pill (Page 1)
The demon pill (demon pill (page 22)) is so bitter. It also has a fishy smell. It is very unpalatable. [Acquired five thousand magic points, and the third-grade spiritual treasure "Attracting Bees and Butterflies Pendant" has been stored in the system space.] Immediately, Ji Nanbei felt that his whole body began to heat up, as if being burned by flames. It was quite painful. But Ji Nanbei could detect that this burning sensation was similar to the previous spiritual energy infusion. This was tempering the physical body. . So Ji Nanbei just let it go and gritted his teeth. To Ji Nanbei's surprise, he thought Su Qianxue would scream in pain, but the little fox didn't make a sound. Ji Nanbei could feel that the other person was also suffering from pain. Obviously, this little fox who couldn't even hunt was not as weak as he seemed. There was a strong resilience. When the burning sensation gradually subsided, Ji Nanbei didn't have time to say a word, and he returned to his body directly. This time, what he received was not the influx of true energy, but a different kind of power. Instead, he felt very comfortable, as if he was soaked in warm water. Then, the body quenching process forced impurities all over his body. After leaving the body, Ji Nanbei's skin was covered with a layer of black dirt. As soon as the body tempering was completed, Ji Nanbei rushed towards the mountain stream and immersed himself in it. He felt that he would die on the spot if he waited for a second. In the stream, Ji Nanbei felt the change in his body, and a look of surprise flashed in his eyes. At this moment, Ji Nanbei noticed that his speed and strength had more than doubled. It has exceeded the level that should be achieved during the Qi training period. Human monks have always been good at using spiritual energy and weapon skills, but their physical strength is inherently weak. At the same level, monks are usually not as strong and fast as monsters, and they can only defeat them by relying on their powerful true energy, mysterious skills, and sophisticated weapons. Except for some cases of extraordinary talent and unique methods, understanding is the orthodox way of human cultivation. Except. He can complete body tempering with the help of the demon clan! In this way, although Ji Nanbei is a human monk, he can also have a strong body comparable to the demon clan. Thinking of this, Ji Nanbei immediately has a new view on Su Qianxue's body. Previously, Ji Nanbei only thought that Su Qianxue could get a lot of techniques from the mysterious and easy-to-use demon clan. The value of the body is ordinary. But at this moment, Su Qianxue's importance to Ji Nanbei has suddenly increased to almost the same level as Xiao Jingxi. At least in terms of the benefits brought by the body, Ji Nanbei took out a set of robes from the system space. It was a second-grade robe that could be protected from ordinary water and fire, and it could be said to be clean. It was convenient. At the same time, Ji Nanbei thought about the spiritual treasure he had just obtained. He took it out from the system space and found a red and translucent jade pendant in the shape of a ring, with a delicate butterfly pendant hanging in the middle, like a lifelike flying butterfly. "Well, this thing is the product of the second option, and the name is not very serious. Could it be another improper object?" Ji Nanbei cast a suspicious look.
